page.intro_en: Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) has released the examination schedule for the Contractual Teaching Associate Recruitment 2026. The Paper-I (General Studies of Rajasthan) is scheduled for November 17, 2026, and Paper-II (Subject-wise) will be conducted from December 07, 2026, to December 21, 2026. Candidates must ensure they meet the eligibility criteria and follow all exam instructions provided by the board.
